verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a public library of workflow or agent templates that users can start from. The closest items are Skills, which are reusable instruction packs that may contain templates, and Organization Skills, an internal shared library run by admins. These are adjacent features scoped to one organization, not a public template gallery for starting workflows.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can start from a public library of workflow templates instead of building from scratch
